title: Jensen Huang Discusses Job Opportunities in AI Infrastructure
description: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has commented on the creation of new jobs in traditional trades due to the growth of AI centers.

sections.heading: Job Creation in Traditional Trades
paragraphs: According to Fortune, Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, has stated that 'a lot' of six-figure jobs in fields such as plumbing and construction will be unlocked due to the need to build new AI centers.

sections.heading: Demand for Workforce Housing
paragraphs: Bloomberg.com reports on the data center boom fueling demand for workforce housing, indicating a significant expansion in the sector.
